item.title: Identity.md's Community Coins Launcher Routes Meme Token Fees Through IMD Burns
item.summary: Identity.md developer Adam (@surfcoderepeat) confirmed Community Coins as a meme token launcher built around $IMD, using Uniswap v4 hooks to route every derivative token's trading fees through a shared ETH/IMD pool with automated burn mechanics — though the code has not yet been independently verified.
